text:
carol: Quick sync — need to finalise deprecation batching window + customer cutover plan for June cohort. We have two enterprise customers (BigCorp, NovaApps) asking for longer grace and pin exceptions. Can we agree on batch cadence, canary %, and exception flow?

sam: Which cohorts specifically? traffic profiles? small vs large?

carol: BigCorp ~200 req/s peak, NovaApps ~25 req/s. Both use pinned versions for embeddings. timeline target: start batch rollouts June 7.

elaine: Proposal: 14-day batch windows. Each window -> canary at 10% traffic for 24h, then 50% for 48h, full cutover after 7 days if no regressions. Pinned customers get automatic 60-day opt-in unless contract says otherwise; pin exceptions require CS+Legal signoff.

vikram: CS note — BigCorp is asking for 120-day notice and a manual opt-out route. Legal will want the opt-out documented. They may accept 60d if we provide compatibility shim.

sam: Engineering feasibility: we can add a compatibility shim + fallback route. Estimate: ~2 engineer-weeks + infra flagging for staged routing. We can limit to 2 cohorts per week to keep rollout safe.

carol: Sounds doable. Two open questions: 1) exception path SLA (how long we maintain shard for pinned old model), 2) automation for rollback if quality regression detected.

elaine: For exceptions: maintain old model for 90 days behind a 'pinned-exception' flag; cost chargeback to sales. For rollback automation: integrate with evals + perf alerts to auto-fallback to previous variant if token-latency or quality thresholds cross.

sam: I'll add rollout flags + canary automation. PR will include:
```sh
./run-rollout --cohort june-07 --canary 10 --monitoring on
```

vikram: I'll create customer comms draft and start Legal loop for BigCorp. Will log exception request in Customer Exceptions board.

carol: Decision: 14-day batch windows, 10% canary, 2 cohorts/week cap, pinned customers get 60d opt-in default, exceptions 90d with cost chargeback and Legal signoff. Action items: @sam open PR with flags (due EOD Fri), @elaine draft comms (due Mon), @vikram file exception ticket for BigCorp, @carol schedule cutover kickoff 6/6.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for model-catalog-canary started at 3598765000 :rocket:

sam: noted. I'll post the PR link once it's up.

elaine: comms draft linked: https://docs.redwood/comm-drafts/deprecation-june (draft)

vikram: logged exception ticket #EXC-1432

carol: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if any blockers. :thumbsup:
